6bsgZ87M.content: No font-size tokens exist in tokens.css and mobile uses other sizes (12, 17, 19), so these stay literals limited to this scale. Shared mobile components (Badge 12, Chip and Segmented 13) keep their own sizes.
6bsgZ87M.name: Note

7QlceVVb.name: Flash

8y5mG7Vw.content: Button, IconButton, Segmented items, Chip, Dropdown. The click registers; the only motion on high-frequency controls.
8y5mG7Vw.name: Purpose

AgCZPVwt.content: Used constantly while reading; any transition gets in the way.
AgCZPVwt.name: Purpose

ECM2kl5m.content: Menus, dropdowns, pickers grow from the trigger's corner (transform-origin). Exit: fade only, 120ms.
ECM2kl5m.name: Purpose

EbejCL68.content: Desktop type scale: six sizes, one role each
EbejCL68.name: Overline

FjDGNF2Z.content: Marks: columns 4px rounded at the data end, 2px gaps between fills, one y-axis per chart (no dual axes), a legend whenever there are two series.
FjDGNF2Z.name: Marks

GlN9CvbV.content: Under prefers-reduced-motion: keep press feedback and the refresh spin (they carry state). Popovers, dialogs, the backdrop and the changed-row flash become opacity-only; the reader split changes instantly.
GlN9CvbV.name: Reduced

Gs4llzKo.content: No staggered entrances; they slow every visit.
Gs4llzKo.name: Purpose

J3ZMoDD1.content: Number: KPI values, dialog titles, Arabic book title · Newsreader / Naskh
J3ZMoDD1.name: Role

component.description: Row in a popover menu. Icon set per instance.

Pf3mc15i.content: Text / Scan / Both: panes resize instead of jumping, so the eye keeps its place.
Pf3mc15i.name: Purpose

Qg3volyw.content: No bars growing in, no counting-up KPIs: it delays reading the number in a data-dense tool.
Qg3volyw.name: Purpose

RgSCYzLC.content: Default is no animation. These are the only motions in the desktop app; each has one job. lamsa file css only takes @keyframes, so the tokens are declared as custom properties in each screen's root css (inherited by everything inside) and read with var(--token, literal) fallbacks. In code they belong on :root.
RgSCYzLC.name: Body

Th9VwkdB.content: Two categorical series, in this order everywhere: engines get the same colour on every chart. Status colours only mean a limit state and always ship with an icon and label. Grid and axes stay recessive. Left half light, right half dark.
Th9VwkdB.name: Body

UzBpZXJr.content: Desktop uses the mobile tokens unchanged (apps/mobile/src/tokens.css, via lamsa.config.json). The colour palette and type scale boards live in qiraa-components.lamsa.json. The desktop renderer should import the same CSS instead of its own theme.ts.
UzBpZXJr.name: Body

component.description: App navigation. One instance per screen: set active, failures (text, e.g. "5 failed") with showFailures only when there are failed pages, and connection. The API host lives in Settings, not here. Selection is instant.
Usage against a limit. Ticks mark the warn (70%) and danger (90%) thresholds; set the fill width per instance. Always pair with a Badge (icon + label) so status is never color alone.
Column heading for data tables. Numeric columns align right (set justify-content on the instance).

b3owvloQ.content: Rows a delta refresh changed fade from accent 12% to transparent, so you see what moved. Book and Activity rows.
b3owvloQ.name: Purpose

component.description: One data-table row. Cells: Pre, Lead (page number), Primary (flexible), Status pill + Tag, up to six right-aligned metrics, Trailing (menu, chevron or link). Set column widths per table with cell overrides so they match the TableHeader row. state=changed plays the refresh flash once; hover colour only, no lift.

bv3OMe5z.content: Icon spins only while data-state="loading"; stops when the fetch settles. The as-of time cross-fades in over 150ms.
bv3OMe5z.name: Purpose

cdjrGiuU.content: Label: caps labels and chart ticks · 600 / 500
cdjrGiuU.name: Role

iSU5H2aZ.content: Nav selection, Scorecard / Trends / Outliers, range switches: used tens of times a day, so instant.
iSU5H2aZ.name: Purpose

ia7MVTWk.content: No row lifts or card scaling on hover. Hover changes colour only.
ia7MVTWk.name: Purpose

mMeMOBPN.content: Small: table cells, meta, captions, helper text
mMeMOBPN.name: Role

component.description: Sidebar destination. Icon and label set per instance. Used inside the Sidebar component, which sets the active one. Selection is instant: no transition.

oJ0aiDon.content: Do not add motion to these, even if it looks nice in isolation.
oJ0aiDon.name: Body

component.description: Chart hover readout: a title (the x value) and one line per series. Text stays in ink tokens; the swatch carries identity.

sWIBbP9E.content: Section title, table page numbers, Arabic headings and reading text
sWIBbP9E.name: Role

component.description: A single headline number with a label and an optional note. Use it only for a number nothing else on the screen shows; never animate the value in.

yp5bTDn0.content: Edit book, Delete page, Page number, OCR error. Backdrop fades 200ms. Exit 150ms.
yp5bTDn0.name: Purpose
